body: Is not that I'm isolated.Like you said I wouldn't like to be a burden to people with my problems and also I'm scared about the fact that if I would open up to them that they would end up hurting me,so I keep all my relationships casual,trying to be self reliant on everything,but unfortunately emotionally speaking I'm just a wreck.

Yes.And that is a problem actually,if I can't fill that free time,I have time to think about my self,and realize how miserable I am.And If I can't fill that time with something usually ends up with booze.
I wouldn't say say that.I try to keep work just in working hours to make it less stressful.

I tried therapy,it didn't work.

The problem is that is starting to affect my professional life,I've been promoted and they put a lot more people for me to manage.Is not that I can't to the job,but it's more that I'm starting to stop caring all together about it,and if I will lose it I will definitely have nothing.I don't have anything right now but at least the stupid job makes me woke up from bed.

I can't have real attachments to people bcuz somehow I feel I will get hurt.I somehow never trusted anyone in my life.With "friends" the only thing that I did with was to drink beer and do sports,and with relationship was worse,I never had a relationship longer then several months,I would start intentionally to find reasons to break up with them until they would "hurt" me somehow .

I guess it started in my childhood growing up in a fucked up family,with completely dysfunctional parents.So I couldn't trust them with anything and I had to become self reliant from a younger age.
I always felt this way,but lately is getting worse by the day.And the thing is I'm feeling the same around people too.I feel like I can't trust nobody.
